summary: Tested invite-only auth system overhaul. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed - login page has no register link, admin can see/use invite modal, setup-account shows error for invalid token, socio cannot see Financeiro in sidebar.

minor.issue: Pending invite users get 401 (no password) instead of 403 (pending status). This is technically correct since password verification fails first, but the error message could be more specific.

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/invite correctly requires admin role (403 for non-admin)
GET /api/auth/invite/validate returns name/email for valid token, 404 for invalid
POST /api/auth/setup-account activates account and returns access_token
Rate limiting configured on login endpoint (10/minute)
Frontend login page has no register/criar conta link
Invite modal has all required fields: name, email, role, cargo, member_id, license, department, phone
Setup account page shows 'Convite Invalido' for invalid tokens
Socio users cannot see Financeiro or Utilizadores in sidebar
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test users with TEST_ prefix were cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 tested the new invite-only auth system.
